text:
marie: Heads up — planning to lift SDK pin for sdk-v2.7 in EU canary tonight (21:00 UTC). small longseq regression flagged on llama3q-8bit in nightly. propose staged taper: 10% -> 30% -> 100% over 60m with telemetry gates. Thoughts?

deploy-bot: unpin request received: id=DB-8342. kicking off canary in eu-west-1. status: starting

aj: Can we delay 1h? want to confirm model variant coverage in redwood-diff eval. ping @sasha for runtime kernel compatibility.

sasha: saw OOM in two canary runs yesterday for quantized kernels when seq>1024, probably KV cache layout mismatch. repro commands:

```
python -m bench.run --model llama3q-8bit --seq 2048 --batch 1
# OOM @ kv_cache_alloc
```

Need runtime shim 2.14.2 patch or restrict max_seq to 1024 for canary.

marie: OK. Two options: (A) apply runtime shim patch now and proceed; (B) restrict canary to max_seq=1024 and proceed with taper. Which is faster?

nate: runtime patch needs a patch release and QA — at least 2 business days. Restricting seq length for canary is quick. recommend option B + telemetry alerts: error_rate>0.5% or latency p95 increase >20%.

aj: Agree. Also add a model fallback mapping: for requests with seq>1024 route to gptx-compat for the next 72h. Add route rule snippet:

```
route {
  when request.seq > 1024 and model == "llama3q-8bit" -> model "gptx-compat"
}
```

sasha: add to canary config: `max_input_tokens: 1024` and `telemetry_checks: ["error_rate", "p95_latency", "oom_count"]`

deploy-bot: canary started: canary-id=canary-2026-07-16-01. current cohort: 10% traffic to sdk-v2.7, runtime=2.14.1, model=llama3q-8bit (max_seq=1024). monitoring hooks attached.

marie: watching dashboards. if any gate trips, rollback to sdk-v2.6 automatically. Rollback runbook link: https://go/release/runbook/unpin-rollback

aj: LGTM. once 30m stable, bump to 30%. marathon watchers: @sasha @nate

sasha: :eyes: seeing a tiny p95 spike ~12% at t+8m, error_rate 0.02% — within tolerance.

nate: OOM counter unchanged. thumbs up. hold for 30m then promote.

deploy-bot: canary promoted to 30% at t+32m. canary-id updated. telemetry: p95 +15%, error_rate 0.05%.

marie: promote to 100% at t+60 unless we see regression >20% p95 or error_rate>0.5%. annotate release notes: "sdk-v2.7: unpin; restricted max_seq for llama3q-8bit; routing fallback to gptx-compat for long sequences."

aj: will add a post-rollout task to schedule runtime shim 2.14.2 and re-evaluate removing seq cap.

sasha: adding issue: #ISSUE-8721

marie: thanks team. closing thread once fully promoted. :thumbsup:
